The builder applies the following default configuration:

- Port: `61616` (see `ArtemisBuilder.ArtemisMainPort`)
- Port: `8161` (see `ArtemisBuilder.ArtemisConsolePort`)
- Environment variable: `ARTEMIS_USER=artemis` (see `ArtemisBuilder.WithUsername(string)`)
- Environment variable: `ARTEMIS_PASSWORD=artemis` (see `ArtemisBuilder.WithPassword(string)`)
- Wait strategy: Waits until a message matching `HTTP Server started` is logged.
